scope: Source identity, DRM fallback and fresh signed-URL recovery
Startup, seek, pause, resume and recovery deadline ownership
Device progress, PCM buffering and audio callback work
Queue handoff, speculative preparation and cancellation
Checkpoint persistence and settings access during playback
Frontend state/position ordering, loading controls, retry and error notices

findings.problem: Loading and buffering report paused=true, so the button labelled Pause loading playback sent Resume.
findings.resolution: Choose Pause from loading intent, independently of the paused observation.
findings.coverage: Actual App DOM integration tests for resolving and buffering, plus transport-control tests.

findings.problem: Retry rebuilt the current selection and restarted it at zero.
findings.resolution: Use Native Resume to retain the active occurrence, source selection and interrupted position.
findings.coverage: Duplicate-occurrence App integration test and native resume-target assertion.

findings.problem: A position update could advance the revision past an unseen pause state or full queue response, leaving stale UI state.
findings.resolution: Track accepted state revisions independently and retain newer positions for the same generation.
findings.coverage: Deferred queue hydration, reordered pause/position delivery and initial hydration regression tests.

findings.problem: External playback requests could leave an obsolete persistent skip banner after Native cleared its failure.
findings.resolution: Clear only the playback-owned notice when the corresponding backend failure disappears.
findings.coverage: App integration test for clearing a skip notice on the next external playback state.

findings.problem: Pause retired the buffering watchdog; resuming the same underrun did not necessarily create a new buffering event.
findings.resolution: Re-announce the underrun on resume and retain the pending Started transition even if PCM arrives before the next worker poll.
findings.coverage: Native regression using the real player control helper without audio hardware; live pause/resume qualification required before publication.

findings.problem: Resume after a recent stall could start a source-refresh deadline before buffering grace, leaving too little time for a fresh signed URL.
findings.resolution: Ready decoders start any future recovery budget at the next failure; restarted decoders receive a fresh bounded recovery opportunity while first startup retains its configured limit.
findings.coverage: Native resume-budget regression plus live pause/resume of an induced underrun before publication.

localValidation.nativeBuildPolicy: Native compilation and the full native suite run in GitHub CI to avoid local memory pressure.

releaseGates: Native platform builds, complete test suites, packaged tool and installer qualification
Actual Linux candidate playback, including pause/resume of an underrun
Responsive playback UI inspection and retention of verified DRM fallback behavior
Review exact draft inventories, source commit and asset checksums before publication
knownQualificationLimit: Windows hosted-runner audio-output consumption may be explicitly deferred only for the existing narrow output_device_unavailable condition. Such evidence remains UNVERIFIED, never PCM success. Physical customer machines and OS security prompts remain outside hosted-runner qualification.
